name: Jirachi
normal: white body, yellow head points, teal-blue wish tags
shiny: white body with a faint pink tint, wish tags turn red
desc: blue tags turn red, body faintly pink
note: Red tags and pinker body from web search summaries citing Fandom and Pokemon GO coverage; Bulbapedia returned 403. Original draft had the body going gold, which was wrong.

name: Monferno
normal: orange-brown fur, cream face/belly, yellow flame parts, blue accents
shiny: orange fur turns red, blue accents turn violet-magenta, cream turns yellow-cream
desc: orange fur to red, blue accents to violet
note: Re-measured; rules changed. Orange fur 55-80 with chroma>0.12 (about 45%) to ~12 (single rule covering 54-82). The old 50>20 rule wrongly caught low-chroma cream at hue 50-60 (shiny cream goes to hue ~104, not red); the cream is only partly caught by the grey tint because its chroma 0.04-0.08 overlaps the hue rule, so medium confidence. Blue 220-260 (7%) to 308-323 via one rule 235>315 width 25. Light greys to hue ~104 at chroma ~0.085. Pixel error 0.113 to 0.065.

name: Luxray
normal: dark charcoal body, light blue underfur and ears, yellow eyes
shiny: blue parts turn gold-yellow-green, yellow eyes turn orange, dark body stays neutral
desc: blue underfur to gold, yellow eyes to orange
note: Re-measured. Blue (200-240, 19%) to ~93-100 with chroma x1.8-2.3. Yellow eyes (80-100, 6%) to ~59-72. Dark grey body (72%) stays neutral (about +0.06 L, no tint). Widening the blue window to 215+-35 or changing the eye rule made pixel error worse, so the original is kept. Pixel error 0.095 to 0.053.

name: Rampardos
normal: blue-grey body, tan skull plate, red-orange markings
note: Fandom wiki says blue parts turn red; fandomspot calls it red. Draft was red-brown via 40; retargeted to red with tighter windows.

name: Drifloon
normal: purple balloon body, yellow patches, white
shiny: yellow body with light blue patches, white kept
desc: purple body turns yellow, yellow patches turn light blue
source: pokemondb.net HOME sprites, normal vs shiny, measured in OKLCh
note: Re-measured, unchanged. Body hue 309 (C0.09) -> 101 (C0.13, L x1.14); yellow patches 96 (C0.16) -> 208 (C0.10, L x0.93); whites unchanged. Rules cut color error from 0.186 to 0.037, no collateral.

name: Croagunk
normal: blue body, cream belly, orange cheek sacs
shiny: light teal-cyan body, pink-red cheek sacs, cream kept
desc: blue body lightens to teal-cyan, orange sacs turn pink-red
source: pokemondb.net HOME sprites, normal vs shiny, measured in OKLCh
note: Body hue 254 (C0.11, L0.54) -> 179 (C0.07, L0.66); orange 45-75 -> 358 (C x0.89, L x0.93); yellow 75-105 and cream greys unchanged, so the orange window was tightened from 22 to 20 to stay off yellow. Error 0.110 -> 0.021.

name: Lumineon
normal: blue-teal body, pale blue and pink fins
shiny: yellow-brown body and fins (eyes turn red)
note: Dotesports says yellow-brown with red eyes. Draft had green. Eyes are skipped textures.

name: Serperior
normal: green body, cream-yellow belly and markings
shiny: blue body, lime-green belly and markings
desc: dark green body turns blue, yellow turns lime
source: pokemondb.net HOME sprites, normal vs shiny, measured in OKLCh
note: Yellow 80-120 -> 121 lime. Body splits by lightness: dark green (L<0.6, hue 155-160, 74% of pixels) -> azure 235 (C x0.72); lighter green (L>0.65, hue 150-155) -> green 132 (C x1.9). Hue windows only separate them near 155, so dark window is 160+-4.5 and light is 148+-7 (sprite-based; texture hues may differ, hence medium). Error 0.103 -> 0.061 (previous rule 0.080).

name: Unfezant
normal: grey-brown feathers, red wattle, teal-green wing accents
shiny: browner feathers, purple-magenta wattle/face, teal accents slightly bluer
desc: red wattle turns magenta-purple, greys get a brown tint
source: pokemondb.net HOME sprites (male sprite), normal vs shiny, measured in OKLCh
note: Red hue ~10 (C0.19) -> 325 (same chroma); green accents sit at hue 155-160 (not 150) -> 177 (C x0.72), window recentered to 158+-15; grey L0.4-0.6 -> hue 58 C0.038; grey L0.6-1.0 -> hue 100 C0.03. Lightness shifts (mid grey darker, light grey lighter) not expressible. Error 0.110 -> 0.078.

name: Woobat
normal: light blue body, dark blue-grey wings, pink nose
shiny: light green body, blue wings, pink kept
desc: light blue body turns light green, grey wings turn blue
source: pokemondb.net HOME sprites, normal vs shiny, measured in OKLCh
note: Re-measured, unchanged. Body 213 (C0.06, L0.82) -> 133 (C0.10, L0.88); neutral mid-grey wing/ear texels (L0.4-0.6) -> hue 265 C0.088; pinks (hue 345-30) not caught. Error 0.106 -> 0.027.

name: Sigilyph
normal: yellow, blue, red and green body parts on black
shiny: lime-green where yellow, orange-yellow where blue, green parts turn pale yellow, red kept
desc: yellow to lime green, blue to orange, green to pale yellow
source: pokemondb.net HOME sprites, normal vs shiny, measured in OKLCh
note: Re-measured, unchanged. Yellow 75-105 -> 121 (29% of pixels); blue 225-240 -> 61 (C0.11 -> 0.12); green 135-150 -> 84 (C x0.5); red 25 and black unchanged (red C slightly lower, skipped). Error 0.112 -> 0.052.

name: Archeops
normal: blue body, yellow crest/belly, red wing feathers, teal accents
shiny: teal-cyan body, paler yellow-green crest, orange-brown wing feathers, blue accents
desc: blue body turns teal-cyan, red feathers turn orange, teal accents turn blue
source: pokemondb.net HOME sprites, normal vs shiny, measured in OKLCh

name: Joltik
normal: yellow body, blue legs and markings, black
shiny: neon green body, darker blue eyes and feet
note: Bulbapedia (via search summary) says neon green vs yellow. Draft said orange.

name: Beheeyem
normal: orange-brown body, tan head, green eyes and markings
shiny: slightly redder brown body, blue eyes and markings
desc: green markings turn blue, body shifts slightly redder
source: pokemondb.net HOME sprites, normal vs shiny, measured in OKLCh
note: Green markings hue ~157 (C0.12) -> 228 blue (C0.08), about 4% of pixels, window recentered to 157+-15; body hue 45-60 -> 37 at C0.06 -> 0.05 (subtle). Error 0.026 -> 0.013.

name: Hydreigon
normal: dark blue-grey body, crimson red parts, blue head and wings
desc: blue parts turn green, red parts turn magenta
source: pokemondb.net HOME sprites, normal vs shiny, measured in OKLCh
note: Blue 245-250 (C0.08) -> 131 green (C0.11); red hue 345-5 (C0.18, 21% of pixels) -> 320 magenta (C0.12, L x1.2). A separate hue 15-30 group (3%) stays unchanged, so the red window was tightened from 3+-18 to 358+-14 to avoid catching it. Neutral dark greys unchanged. Error 0.098 -> 0.029.

name: Pancham
normal: white/cream face and belly, neutral grey-black fur
shiny: brown fur, cream-white face and belly
desc: grey fur turns brown, white turns cream
source: pokemondb.net HOME sprites, normal vs shiny, measured in OKLCh
note: Re-measured, unchanged. 98% of normal pixels are neutral. Mid grey (L0.35-0.6) -> hue 39-51 C0.055; L0.6-0.8 -> hue 68; white (L0.8-1.0) -> hue 93 C0.04 (cream); black below L0.05 stays black. Shiny near-black pixels are lighter (L0.34), which grey rules cannot do. Error 0.069 -> 0.049.

name: Talonflame
normal: red-orange body, dark grey wings, beige underside
shiny: red body, deep red wings, beige underside
desc: dark grey wings turn red, body deepens to red
source: pokemondb.net HOME sprites, normal vs shiny, measured in OKLCh
note: Body hue 31 -> 28 (C0.187 -> 0.18), too small to rule; dark neutral grey (L0.2-0.45, 42% of pixels) -> red hue 26 C0.17, L0.34 -> 0.48 (chroma 0.15 because the grey rule cannot lighten; scored better than 0.12); light greys -> beige hue 60 C0.07. Error 0.112 -> 0.078.

name: Espurr
normal: lavender-grey fur, cream face, yellow eyes, purple ear insides
shiny: pale pink-white fur, eyes and ear insides unchanged
source: pokemondb.net HOME sprites, normal vs shiny, measured in OKLCh
note: Fur (grey, 90% of pixels) hue 288, C0.035, L0.83 -> hue 340, C0.04, L0.91 (lighter, not fully expressible); a colored lavender fringe at hue 285-300 (5%) -> 330 added as 291>331:9; ear insides (hue ~315) and eyes (hue ~250) unchanged. Change is subtle. Error 0.078 -> 0.069.

name: Clawitzer
normal: blue body, large blue claw, yellow-white accents
shiny: red body with white, some blue accents kept
note: Two sources describe red and white with blue accents. Draft green-teal was wrong.
